name: Unit-01 in the Ruins / 废墟中的初号机
credit: No artist credit: the 哲风壁纸 (haowallpaper.com) page that hosts this artwork names only its uploader, and the same picture also circulates on wallhaven as x85po3, uploaded there by BachoWilson. The full-size original reached this project as a user-supplied file.
note: Hotlinked, never redistributed: this repository carries no image bytes. The artwork's own file is 3066x2160, but haowallpaper serves anonymous visitors only this 1100x775 preview -- the larger one needs a signed-in download. A machine that holds the original can embed it through the git-ignored local manifest instead, which is what the maintainer's install does.
